import pathlib
p = pathlib.Path('/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-guillaumeloulier-PhpstormProjects-oss-elephc--claude-worktrees-streams-csv-signature/c8dbe38f-1f79-484f-9b83-62bacab9ca56/scratchpad/uv/add_plain_files_guard.py')
t = p.read_text()
t = t.replace('''    let proceed = format!("__rt_plain_files_ok_{}", emitter.next_local_id());
    match emitter.target.arch {''', '''    // A GAS numeric local label, so the emitter needs no unique-name bookkeeping and two helpers
    // guarded in the same file cannot collide. `1f` is the next `1:` forward.
    match emitter.target.arch {''')
t = t.replace('emitter.instruction(&format!("b.eq {proceed}"));                    // file:// is registered: carry on',
              'emitter.instruction("b.eq 1f");                                     // file:// is registered: carry on')
t = t.replace('emitter.instruction(&format!("jz {proceed}"));                      // file:// is registered: carry on',
              'emitter.instruction("jz 1f");                                       // file:// is registered: carry on')
t = t.replace('            emitter.label(&proceed);\n        }\n        Arch::X86_64', '            emitter.label("1");\n        }\n        Arch::X86_64')
t = t.replace('            emitter.label(&proceed);\n        }\n    }\n}', '            emitter.label("1");\n        }\n    }\n}')
p.write_text(t)
print('emitter uses GAS numeric local labels')
